items.title: 8.16.2 Preparation of sulphur trioxide (sulphur trioxide banana) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.2, printed pages 184-185, with the second Quick Check 8.6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: H₂SO₄ (sulphuric acid) banane ke liye SO₂ aur O₂ se reversible process mein sulphur trioxide gas banai jati hai.

Le-Chatelier ke principle ke mutabiq SO₃ ki behtar yield ke liye zyada pressure aur kam temperature zaroori hain. Kam temperature par SO₃ banne ka equilibrium constant bara hota hai, magar equilibrium bohat slow (dheere) aata hai. Temperature barhane se rate barhti hai magar SO₃ ki yield gir jati hai.
Neeche Table 8.2 dikhati hai ke 1 atmosphere pressure par kya hota hai.
